Human: Generate a complete medium-size Python 3.10 repository architecture for: Video player.

This architecture will be implemented later by a seeded local code model and evaluated automatically. Produce concrete design and implementation tasks for every file; do not use placeholders.

Normative evaluator protocol (these paths are mandatory and override preferences):
- build file: requirements.txt
- runtime entry: Main.py
- single test target: tests/test_main.py
- test command: python -m pytest -q
- keep exactly one protocol-level test file; additional non-test implementation files are allowed

Language/layout constraints:
Keep Main.py as a thin entrypoint and put reusable modules in a lowercase snake_case package. List pytest in requirements.txt and avoid other external dependencies unless essential. Target Python 3.10 exactly: do not use typing.Self, StrEnum, exception groups, or other Python 3.11+ APIs. Design an acyclic import graph: foundational types/errors may not import engines, entrypoints, or demos; __init__.py may export only symbols actually defined by submodules.

Medium-size target from MetaProjectDev (an approximate architecture target, not permission to violate the protocol):
- about 9 repository files
- about 37 functions or methods
- about 786 lines of code

File-count quality gate:
- the complete Task list MUST contain between 8 and 10 files inclusive
- count build, runtime, test, package markers, headers, and implementation files in that total
- combine closely related small types instead of exceeding this budget

Required domain behavior:
- media metadata
- playlist navigation
- play pause and stop state
- seek and duration bounds
- volume and mute
- headless deterministic playback clock

Cross-cutting requirements:
- separate pure domain logic from runtime, UI, filesystem, network, clock, and randomness boundaries
- automated tests must be deterministic, headless, offline, and require no manual interaction
- keep the single test target concise (2 to 4 tests, preferably under 150 LOC): cover runtime wiring and representative core rules, not the full feature matrix
- do not inflate the function/LOC target with test code; put substantive behavior in implementation files
- make every planned file small enough for one 4096-token code completion: prefer under 150 LOC and never plan a file over 220 LOC
- order the Task list strictly by implementation dependency: foundational types and interfaces first, then dependent implementations, then the runtime entry, and the single test target LAST (the build descriptor may be first)
- the Engineer code_todos must preserve that dependency-first Task-list order so later files can see already-generated dependency code
- the runtime entry must provide a small non-interactive demonstration that exits successfully or starts safely without an output loop
- validate invalid inputs and boundary cases
- keep public interfaces coherent across design, task list, implementation, and tests
- specify one canonical public API; tests must use it without inventing alternate semantics
- make Full API spec non-empty and exhaustive: for every public type/function give its exact module, signature, return value, error behavior, and key semantics; repeat these exact contracts in each affected file task
- tests may import only the canonical public API and should assert stable externally visible behavior, not private implementation details, incidental formatting, or unplanned aliases
- avoid circular dependencies; explicitly give the allowed import/include direction and ensure every referenced symbol is defined before a dependent file is generated
- avoid network access and OS-specific behavior during build, tests, and runtime checks
- all planned source, header, build, and test files must be listed exactly and consistently in the design and task documents

idempotent add allowed; listener called synchronously on tick in registration order.\\n  - remove_tick_listener(self, fn) -> None: unregisters a previously added listener; no-op if not present.\\n  - tick(self, delta_seconds: float) -> None: advances clock by delta_seconds (> 0) and synchronously notifies listeners via fn(delta_seconds). Raises ValidationError for NaN or negative infinite values; finite negatives clamp to 0.0.\\n  - set_volume(self, v: float) -> float: sets volume to clamp(v, 0.0, 1.0); returns effective volume.\\n  - get_volume(self) -> float: returns current volume (0.0..1.0), independent of muted flag.\\n  - mute(self) -> None: sets muted True.\\n  - unmute(self) -> None: sets muted False.\\n  - toggle_mute(self) -> bool: flips muted and returns new muted state.\\n  - effective_volume(self) -> float: returns 0.0 if muted else get_volume().\\n  - next_media(self) -> Media | None: requests playlist.next(); if a next item exists, resets position to 0.0 and sets state to STOPPED; returns the Media or None if at end.\\n  - previous_media(self) -> Media | None: requests playlist.previous(); if a previous item exists, resets position to 0.0 and sets state to STOPPED; returns the Media or None if at start.\\n  - select_index(self, i: int) -> Media: delegates to playlist.select(i); resets position to 0.0 and sets state to STOPPED; returns selected Media.\\n  - _on_tick(self, delta: float) -> None: internal; invoked by ManualClock ticks; advances position only when state is PLAYING and a current media exists; clamps at duration and transitions to STOPPED when reaching or exceeding end, leaving position at exact duration.\\n  - _reset_position(self) -> None: internal; sets position to 0.0.\\n\\nSemantics\\n- Deterministic, headless, tick-driven: Player time advances only via ManualClock.tick calls; no wall-clock usage. metagpt.actions.add_requirement.UserRequ.content:
Generate a complete medium-size Python 3.10 repository architecture for: Video player.

This architecture will be implemented later by a seeded local code model and evaluated automatically. Produce concrete design and implementation tasks for every file; do not use placeholders.

Normative evaluator protocol (these paths are mandatory and override preferences):
- build file: requirements.txt
- runtime entry: Main.py
- single test target: tests/test_main.py
- test command: python -m pytest -q
- keep exactly one protocol-level test file; additional non-test implementation files are allowed

Language/layout constraints:
Keep Main.py as a thin entrypoint and put reusable modules in a lowercase snake_case package. List pytest in requirements.txt and avoid other external dependencies unless essential. Target Python 3.10 exactly: do not use typing.Self, StrEnum, exception groups, or other Python 3.11+ APIs. Design an acyclic import graph: foundational types/errors may not import engines, entrypoints, or demos; __init__.py may export only symbols actually defined by submodules.

Medium-size target from MetaProjectDev (an approximate architecture target, not permission to violate the protocol):
- about 9 repository files
- about 37 functions or methods
- about 786 lines of code

File-count quality gate:
- the complete Task list MUST contain between 8 and 10 files inclusive
- count build, runtime, test, package markers, headers, and implementation files in that total
- combine closely related small types instead of exceeding this budget

Required domain behavior:
- media metadata
- playlist navigation
- play pause and stop state
- seek and duration bounds
- volume and mute
- headless deterministic playback clock

Cross-cutting requirements:
- separate pure domain logic from runtime, UI, filesystem, network, clock, and randomness boundaries
- automated tests must be deterministic, headless, offline, and require no manual interaction
- keep the single test target concise (2 to 4 tests, preferably under 150 LOC): cover runtime wiring and representative core rules, not the full feature matrix
- do not inflate the function/LOC target with test code; put substantive behavior in implementation files
- make every planned file small enough for one 4096-token code completion: prefer under 150 LOC and never plan a file over 220 LOC
- order the Task list strictly by implementation dependency: foundational types and interfaces first, then dependent implementations, then the runtime entry, and the single test target LAST (the build descriptor may be first)
- the Engineer code_todos must preserve that dependency-first Task-list order so later files can see already-generated dependency code
- the runtime entry must provide a small non-interactive demonstration that exits successfully or starts safely without an output loop
- validate invalid inputs and boundary cases
- keep public interfaces coherent across design, task list, implementation, and tests
- specify one canonical public API; tests must use it without inventing alternate semantics
- make Full API spec non-empty and exhaustive: for every public type/function give its exact module, signature, return value, error behavior, and key semantics; repeat these exact contracts in each affected file task
- tests may import only the canonical public API and should assert stable externally visible behavior, not private implementation details, incidental formatting, or unplanned aliases
- avoid circular dependencies; explicitly give the allowed import/include direction and ensure every referenced symbol is defined before a dependent file is generated
- avoid network access and OS-specific behavior during build, tests, and runtime checks
- all planned source, header, build, and test files must be listed exactly and consistently in the design and task documents

Package: video_player
- video_player.__init__ re-exports: ValidationError, StateError, NotFoundError; Media; ManualClock; Playlist; Player; PlaybackState.
- Import graph must be acyclic: errors -> media -> playlist -> player; clock is orthogonal and imported by player only; tests and Main.py import from video_player or submodules without creating cycles.

Exceptions (video_player.errors)
- class ValidationError(Exception): raised for invalid inputs and configuration.
- class StateError(ValidationError): raised for invalid state transitions (e.g., play with empty playlist).
- class NotFoundError(ValidationError): raised when addressing non-existent playlist indices/items.

Entity: Media (video_player.media)
- class Media:
  - __init__(self, id: str, title: str, duration_seconds: float, metadata: Optional[dict] = None)
    - id: non-empty str
    - title: non-empty str
    - duration_seconds: float > 0
    - metadata: optional dict; stored as a shallow copy; object is immutable after construction (no setters; attributes may be read-only via properties or by convention).
  - Attributes (public, read-only): id, title, duration_seconds, metadata (a shallow-copied dict or {})
  - Errors: ValidationError for invalid field types/values.

Clock: ManualClock (video_player.clock)
- class ManualClock:
  - now(self) -> float: returns accumulated clock time in seconds.
  - add_tick_listener(self, fn: Callable[[float], None]) -> None: registers a listener to receive tick deltas; idempotent add allowed; listener called synchronously on tick in registration order.
  - remove_tick_listener(self, fn) -> None: unregisters a previously added listener; no-op if not present.
  - tick(self, delta_seconds: float) -> None: advances clock by delta_seconds (> 0) and synchronously notifies listeners via fn(delta_seconds). Raises ValidationError if delta_seconds <= 0.

Playlist (video_player.playlist)
- class Playlist:
  - __init__(self, items: list[Media]): stores an immutable snapshot list of Media; initial _current_index is 0 if non-empty else None.
  - is_empty(self) -> bool: True if no items.
  - size(self) -> int: number of items.
  - current(self) -> Media | None: current Media if selected else None.
  - select(self, index: int) -> Media: selects and returns item at index; raises NotFoundError for out-of-range; sets current index to index.
  - next(self) -> Media | None: if empty, return None; if at last item, keep last and return None; otherwise advance index by 1 and return the new current item.
  - previous(self) -> Media | None: if empty, return None; if at first item, keep first and return None; otherwise decrement index by 1 and return the new current item.
  - Invariants: indices are 0-based; navigation does not wrap; selection maintains bounds.

PlaybackState (video_player.player)
- enum-like class PlaybackState with three members: STOPPED, PLAYING, PAUSED. Comparable by identity or value; string reprs stable.

Player (video_player.player)
- class Player:
  - __init__(self, playlist: Playlist, clock: ManualClock): subscribes an internal _on_tick listener to clock; initializes state STOPPED, position 0.0, volume 1.0, muted False. If playlist not empty, current selection is as in Playlist (index 0 by default).
  - state(self) -> PlaybackState: returns current playback state.
  - current_media(self) -> Media | None: returns playlist.current().
  - position_seconds(self) -> float: current position within current media in seconds; 0.0 when no selection.
  - duration_seconds(self) -> float: duration of current media in seconds; 0.0 when no selection.
  - play(self) -> None: transitions to PLAYING if a media is selected; if playlist is empty, raises StateError; if at end (position >= duration), resets to 0.0 before playing.
  - pause(self) -> None: transitions to PAUSED from PLAYING; no-op if already PAUSED or STOPPED (remains STOPPED).
  - stop(self) -> None: transitions to STOPPED and resets position to 0.0.
  - seek(self, seconds: float) -> float: clamps seconds to [0.0, duration_seconds()] and sets position; returns the effective position. If no media selected, returns 0.0 and leaves state STOPPED. Raises ValidationError for NaN or negative infinite values; finite negatives clamp to 0.0.
  - set_volume(self, v: float) -> float: sets volume to clamp(v, 0.0, 1.0); returns effective volume.
  - get_volume(self) -> float: returns current volume (0.0..1.0), independent of muted flag.
  - mute(self) -> None: sets muted True.
  - unmute(self) -> None: sets muted False.
  - toggle_mute(self) -> bool: flips muted and returns new muted state.
  - effective_volume(self) -> float: returns 0.0 if muted else get_volume().
  - next_media(self) -> Media | None: requests playlist.next(); if a next item exists, resets position to 0.0 and sets state to STOPPED; returns the Media or None if at end.
  - previous_media(self) -> Media | None: requests playlist.previous(); if a previous item exists, resets position to 0.0 and sets state to STOPPED; returns the Media or None if at start.
  - select_index(self, i: int) -> Media: delegates to playlist.select(i); resets position to 0.0 and sets state to STOPPED; returns selected Media.
  - _on_tick(self, delta: float) -> None: internal; invoked by ManualClock ticks; advances position only when state is PLAYING and a current media exists; clamps at duration and transitions to STOPPED when reaching or exceeding end, leaving position at exact duration.
  - _reset_position(self) -> None: internal; sets position to 0.0.

Semantics
- Deterministic, headless, tick-driven: Player time advances only via ManualClock.tick calls; no wall-clock usage. End-of-media behavior: when position + delta >= duration, set position to duration and set state to STOPPED.
- No I/O, no GUI/audio/network/filesystem side effects anywhere in core modules.

Media; ManualClock; Playlist; Player; PlaybackState.\\n- Import graph must be acyclic: errors -> media -> playlist -> player; clock is orthogonal and imported by player only; tests and Main.py import from video_player or submodules without creating cycles.\\n\\nExceptions (video_player.errors)\\n- class ValidationError(Exception): raised for invalid inputs and configuration.\\n- class StateError(ValidationError): raised for invalid state transitions (e.g., play with empty playlist).\\n- class NotFoundError(ValidationError): raised when addressing non-existent playlist indices/items.\\n\\nEntity: Media (video_player.media)\\n- class Media:\\n  - __init__(self, id: str, title: str, duration_seconds: float, metadata: Optional[dict] = None)\\n    - id: non-empty str\\n    - title: non-empty str\\n    - duration_seconds: float > 0\\n    - metadata: optional dict; stored as a shallow copy; object is immutable after construction (no setters; attributes may be read-only via properties or by convention).\\n  - Attributes (public, read-only): id, title, duration_seconds, metadata (a shallow-copied dict or {})\\n  - Errors: ValidationError for invalid field types/values.\\n\\nClock: ManualClock (video_player.clock)\\n- class ManualClock:\\n  - now(self) -> float: returns accumulated clock time in seconds.\\n  - add_tick_listener(self, fn: Callable[[float], None]) -> None: registers a listener to receive tick deltas; idempotent add allowed; listener called synchronously on tick in registration order.\\n  - remove_tick_listener(self, fn) -> None: unregisters a previously added listener; no-op if not present.\\n  - tick(self, delta_seconds: float) -> None: advances clock by delta_seconds (> 0) and synchronously notifies listeners via fn(delta_seconds). Raises ValidationError if delta_seconds <= 0.\\n\\nPlaylist (video_player.playlist)\\n- class Playlist:\\n  - __init__(self, items: list[Media]): stores an immutable snapshot list of Media; initial _current_index is 0 if non-empty else None.\\n  - is_empty(self) -> bool: True if no items.\\n  - size(self) -> int: number of items.\\n  - current(self) -> Media | None: current Media if selected else None.\\n  - select(self, index: int) -> Media: selects and returns item at index; raises NotFoundError for out-of-range; sets current index to index.\\n  - next(self) -> Media | None: if empty, return None; if at last item, keep last and return None; otherwise advance index by 1 and return the new current item.\\n  - previous(self) -> Media | None: if empty, return None; if at first item, keep first and return None; otherwise decrement index by 1 and return the new current item.\\n  - Invariants: indices are 0-based; navigation does not wrap; selection maintains bounds.\\n\\nPlaybackState (video_player.player)\\n- enum-like class PlaybackState with three members: STOPPED, PLAYING, PAUSED. Comparable by identity or value; string reprs stable.\\n\\nPlayer (video_player.player)\\n- class Player:\\n  - __init__(self, playlist: Playlist, clock: ManualClock): subscribes an internal _on_tick listener to clock; initializes state STOPPED, position 0.0, volume 1.0, muted False. If playlist not empty, current selection is as in Playlist (index 0 by default).\\n  - state(self) -> PlaybackState: returns current playback state.\\n  - current_media(self) -> Media | None: returns playlist.current().\\n  - position_seconds(self) -> float: current position within current media in seconds; 0.0 when no selection.\\n  - duration_seconds(self) -> float: duration of current media in seconds; 0.0 when no selection.\\n  - play(self) -> None: transitions to PLAYING if a media is selected; if playlist is empty, raises StateError; if at end (position >= duration), resets to 0.0 before playing.\\n  - pause(self) -> None: transitions to PAUSED from PLAYING; no-op if already PAUSED or STOPPED (remains STOPPED).\\n  - stop(self) -> None: transitions to STOPPED and resets position to 0.0.\\n  - seek(self, seconds: float) -> float: clamps seconds to [0.0, duration_seconds()] and sets position; returns the effective position. If no media selected, returns 0.0 and leaves state STOPPED. Raises ValidationError for NaN or negative infinite values; finite negatives clamp to 0.0.\\n  - set_volume(self, v: float) -> float: sets volume to clamp(v, 0.0, 1.0); returns effective volume.\\n  - get_volume(self) -> float: returns current volume (0.0..1.0), independent of muted flag.\\n  - mute(self) -> None: sets muted True.\\n  - unmute(self) -> None: sets muted False.\\n  - toggle_mute(self) -> bool: flips muted and returns new muted state.\\n  - effective_volume(self) -> float: returns 0.0 if muted else get_volume().\\n  - next_media(self) -> Media | None: requests playlist.next(); if a next item exists, resets position to 0.0 and sets state to STOPPED; returns the Media or None if at end.\\n  - previous_media(self) -> Media | None: requests playlist.previous(); if a previous item exists, resets position to 0.0 and sets state to STOPPED; returns the Media or None if at start.\\n  - select_index(self, i: int) -> Media: delegates to playlist.select(i); resets position to 0.0 and sets state to STOPPED; returns selected Media.\\n  - _on_tick(self, delta: float) -> None: internal; invoked by ManualClock ticks; advances position only when state is PLAYING and a current media exists; clamps at duration and transitions to STOPPED when reaching or exceeding end, leaving position at exact duration.\\n  - _reset_position(self) -> None: internal; sets position to 0.0.\\n\\nSemantics\\n- Deterministic, headless, tick-driven: Player time advances only via ManualClock.tick calls; no wall-clock usage. End-of-media behavior: when position + delta >= duration, set position to duration and set state to STOPPED.\\n- No I/O, no GUI/audio/network/filesystem side effects anywhere in core modules.\\n\\n__init__ exports (video_player.__init__)\\n- from .errors import ValidationError, StateError, NotFoundError\\n- from .media import Media\\n- from .clock import ManualClock\\n- from .playlist import Playlist\\n- from .player import Player, PlaybackState\\n\\nImport constraints\\n- errors is leaf; media imports errors; playlist imports media and errors; player imports errors, media, playlist, and clock; clock imports nothing from domain; __init__ re-exports only.\\n\\nRuntime entry (Main.py)\\n- Constructs a small list of Media, a Playlist, a ManualClock, and a Player. Demonstrates play/pause/seek/next and ticks deterministically, then exits without interaction or I/O.\",\"Shared Knowledge\":\"The project provides a headless, deterministic video player domain. Media; ManualClock; Playlist; Player; PlaybackState.\\n- Import graph must be acyclic: errors -> media -> playlist -> player; clock is orthogonal and imported by player only; tests and Main.py import from video_player or submodules without creating cycles.\\n\\nExceptions (video_player.errors)\\n- class ValidationError(Exception): raised for invalid inputs and configuration.\\n- class StateError(ValidationError): raised for invalid state transitions (e.g., play with empty playlist).\\n- class NotFoundError(ValidationError): raised when addressing non-existent playlist indices/items.\\n\\nEntity: Media (video_player.media)\\n- class Media:\\n  - __init__(self, id: str, title: str, duration_seconds: float, metadata: Optional[dict] = None)\\n    - id: non-empty str\\n    - title: non-empty str\\n    - duration_seconds: float > 0\\n    - metadata: optional dict; stored as a shallow copy; object is immutable after construction (no setters; attributes may be read-only via properties or by convention).\\n  - Attributes (public, read-only): id, title, duration_seconds, metadata (a shallow-copied dict or {})\\n  - Errors: ValidationError for invalid field types/values.\\n\\nClock: ManualClock (video_player.clock)\\n- class ManualClock:\\n  - now(self) -> float: returns accumulated clock time in seconds.\\n  - add_tick_listener(self, fn: Callable[[float], None]) -> None: registers a listener to receive tick deltas; idempotent add allowed; listener called synchronously on tick in registration order.\\n  - remove_tick_listener(self, fn) -> None: unregisters a previously added listener; no-op if not present.\\n  - tick(self, delta_seconds: float) -> None: advances clock by delta_seconds (> 0) and synchronously notifies listeners via fn(delta_seconds). Raises ValidationError if delta_seconds <= 0.\\n\\nPlaylist (video_player.playlist)\\n- class Playlist:\\n  - __init__(self, items: list[Media]): stores an immutable snapshot list of Media; initial _current_index is 0 if non-empty else None.\\n  - is_empty(self) -> bool: True if no items.\\n  - size(self) -> int: number of items.\\n  - current(self) -> Media | None: current Media if selected else None.\\n  - select(self, index: int) -> Media: selects and returns item at index; raises NotFoundError for out-of-range; sets current index to index.\\n  - next(self) -> Media | None: if empty, return None; if at last item, keep last and return None; otherwise advance index by 1 and return the new current item.\\n  - previous(self) -> Media | None: if empty, return None; if at first item, keep first and return None; otherwise decrement index by 1 and return the new current item.\\n  - Invariants: indices are 0-based; navigation does not wrap; selection maintains bounds.\\n\\nPlaybackState (video_player.player)\\n- enum-like class PlaybackState with three members: STOPPED, PLAYING, PAUSED. Comparable by identity or value; string reprs stable.\\n\\nPlayer (video_player.player)\\n- class Player:\\n  - __init__(self, playlist: Playlist, clock: ManualClock): subscribes an internal _on_tick listener to clock; initializes state STOPPED, position 0.0, volume 1.0, muted False. If playlist not empty, current selection is as in Playlist (index 0 by default).\\n  - state(self) -> PlaybackState: returns current playback state.\\n  - current_media(self) -> Media | None: returns playlist.current().\\n  - position_seconds(self) -> float: current position within current media in seconds; 0.0 when no selection.\\n  - duration_seconds(self) -> float: duration of current media in seconds; 0.0 when no selection.\\n  - play(self) -> None: transitions to PLAYING if a media is selected; if playlist is empty, raises StateError; if at end (position >= duration), resets to 0.0 before playing.\\n  - pause(self) -> None: transitions to PAUSED from PLAYING; no-op if already PAUSED or STOPPED (remains STOPPED).\\n  - stop(self) -> None: transitions to STOPPED and resets position to 0.0.\\n  - seek(self, seconds: float) -> float: clamps seconds to [0.0, duration_seconds()] and sets position; returns the effective position. If no media selected, returns 0.0 and leaves state STOPPED. Raises ValidationError for NaN or negative infinite values; finite negatives clamp to 0.0.\\n  - set_volume(self, v: float) -> float: sets volume to clamp(v, 0.0, 1.0); returns effective volume.\\n  - get_volume(self) -> float: returns current volume (0.0..1.0), independent of muted flag.\\n  - mute(self) -> None: sets muted True.\\n  - unmute(self) -> None: sets muted False.\\n  - toggle_mute(self) -> bool: flips muted and returns new muted state.\\n  - effective_volume(self) -> float: returns 0.0 if muted else get_volume().\\n  - next_media(self) -> Media | None: requests playlist.next(); if a next item exists, resets position to 0.0 and sets state to STOPPED; returns the Media or None if at end.\\n  - previous_media(self) -> Media | None: requests playlist.previous(); if a previous item exists, resets position to 0.0 and sets state to STOPPED; returns the Media or None if at start.\\n  - select_index(self, i: int) -> Media: delegates to playlist.select(i); resets position to 0.0 and sets state to STOPPED; returns selected Media.\\n  - _on_tick(self, delta: float) -> None: internal; invoked by ManualClock ticks; advances position only when state is PLAYING and a current media exists; clamps at duration and transitions to STOPPED when reaching or exceeding end, leaving position at exact duration.\\n  - _reset_position(self) -> None: internal; sets position to 0.0.\\n\\nSemantics\\n- Deterministic, headless, tick-driven: Player time advances only via ManualClock.tick calls; no wall-clock usage. End-of-media behavior: when position + delta >= duration, set position to duration and set state to STOPPED.\\n- No I/O, no GUI/audio/network/filesystem side effects anywhere in core modules.\\n\\n__init__ exports (video_player.__init__)\\n- from .errors import ValidationError, StateError, NotFoundError\\n- from .media import Media\\n- from .clock import ManualClock\\n- from .playlist import Playlist\\n- from .player import Player, PlaybackState\\n\\nImport constraints\\n- errors is leaf; media imports errors; playlist imports media and errors; player imports errors, media, playlist, and clock; clock imports nothing from domain; __init__ re-exports only.\\n\\nRuntime entry (Main.py)\\n- Constructs a small list of Media, a Playlist, a ManualClock, and a Player. Demonstrates play/pause/seek/next and ticks deterministically, then exits without interaction or I/O.\",\"Shared Knowledge\":\"The project provides a headless, deterministic video player domain. Raises ValidationError if delta_seconds <= 0.\\n\\nPlaylist (video_player.playlist)\\n- class Playlist:\\n  - __init__(self, items: list[Media]): stores an immutable snapshot list of Media; initial _current_index is 0 if non-empty else None.\\n  - is_empty(self) -> bool: True if no items.\\n  - size(self) -> int: number of items.\\n  - current(self) -> Media | None: current Media if selected else None.\\n  - select(self, index: int) -> Media: selects and returns item at index; raises NotFoundError for out-of-range; sets current index to index.\\n  - next(self) -> Media | None: if empty, return None; if at last item, keep last and return None; otherwise advance index by 1 and return the new current item.\\n  - previous(self) -> Media | None: if empty, return None; if at first item, keep first and return None; otherwise decrement index by 1 and return the new current item.\\n  - Invariants: indices are 0-based; navigation does not wrap; selection maintains bounds.\\n\\nPlaybackState (video_player.player)\\n- enum-like class PlaybackState with three members: STOPPED, PLAYING, PAUSED. If no media selected, returns 0.0 and leaves state STOPPED. Raises ValidationError for NaN or negative infinite values; finite negatives clamp to 0.0.\\n  - set_volume(self, v: float) -> float: sets volume to clamp(v, 0.0, 1.0); returns effective volume.\\n  - get_volume(self) -> float: returns current volume (0.0..1.0), independent of muted flag.\\n  - mute(self) -> None: sets muted True.\\n  - unmute(self) -> None: sets muted False.\\n  - toggle_mute(self) -> bool: flips muted and returns new muted state.\\n  - effective_volume(self) -> float: returns 0.0 if muted else get_volume().\\n  - next_media(self) -> Media | None: requests playlist.next(); if a next item exists, resets position to 0.0 and sets state to STOPPED; returns the Media or None if at end.\\n  - previous_media(self) -> Media | None: requests playlist.previous(); if a previous item exists, resets position to 0.0 and sets state to STOPPED; returns the Media or None if at start.\\n  - select_index(self, i: int) -> Media: delegates to playlist.select(i); resets position to 0.0 and sets state to STOPPED; returns selected Media.\\n  - _on_tick(self, delta: float) -> None: internal; invoked by ManualClock ticks; advances position only when state is PLAYING and a current media exists; clamps at duration and transitions to STOPPED when reaching or exceeding end, leaving position at exact duration.\\n  - _reset_position(self) -> None: internal; sets position to 0.0.\\n\\nSemantics\\n- Deterministic, headless, tick-driven: Player time advances only via ManualClock.tick calls; no wall-clock usage. Media; ManualClock; Playlist; Player; PlaybackState.\\n- Import graph must be acyclic: errors -> media -> playlist -> player; clock is orthogonal and imported by player only; tests and Main.py import from video_player or submodules without creating cycles.\\n\\nExceptions (video_player.errors)\\n- class ValidationError(Exception): raised for invalid inputs and configuration.\\n- class StateError(ValidationError): raised for invalid state transitions (e.g., play with empty playlist).\\n- class NotFoundError(ValidationError): raised when addressing non-existent playlist indices/items.\\n\\nEntity: Media (video_player.media)\\n- class Media:\\n  - __init__(self, id: str, title: str, duration_seconds: float, metadata: Optional[dict] = None)\\n    - id: non-empty str\\n    - title: non-empty str\\n    - duration_seconds: float > 0\\n    - metadata: optional dict; stored as a shallow copy; object is immutable after construction (no setters; attributes may be read-only via properties or by convention).\\n  - Attributes (public, read-only): id, title, duration_seconds, metadata (a shallow-copied dict or {})\\n  - Errors: ValidationError for invalid field types/values.\\n\\nClock: ManualClock (video_player.clock)\\n- class ManualClock:\\n  - now(self) -> float: returns accumulated clock time in seconds.\\n  - add_tick_listener(self, fn: Callable[[float], None]) -> None: registers a listener to receive tick deltas; idempotent add allowed; listener called synchronously on tick in registration order.\\n  - remove_tick_listener(self, fn) -> None: unregisters a previously added listener; no-op if not present.\\n  - tick(self, delta_seconds: float) -> None: advances clock by delta_seconds (> 0) and synchronously notifies listeners via fn(delta_seconds). Raises ValidationError if delta_seconds <= 0.\\n\\nPlaylist (video_player.playlist)\\n- class Playlist:\\n  - __init__(self, items: list[Media]): stores an immutable snapshot list of Media; initial _current_index is 0 if non-empty else None.\\n  - is_empty(self) -> bool: True if no items.\\n  - size(self) -> int: number of items.\\n  - current(self) -> Media | None: current Media if selected else None.\\n  - select(self, index: int) -> Media: selects and returns item at index; raises NotFoundError for out-of-range; sets current index to index.\\n  - next(self) -> Media | None: if empty, return None; if at last item, keep last and return None; otherwise advance index by 1 and return the new current item.\\n  - previous(self) -> Media | None: if empty, return None; if at first item, keep first and return None; otherwise decrement index by 1 and return the new current item.\\n  - Invariants: indices are 0-based; navigation does not wrap; selection maintains bounds.\\n\\nPlaybackState (video_player.player)\\n- enum-like class PlaybackState with three members: STOPPED, PLAYING, PAUSED. Comparable by identity or value; string reprs stable.\\n\\nPlayer (video_player.player)\\n- class Player:\\n  - __init__(self, playlist: Playlist, clock: ManualClock): subscribes an internal _on_tick listener to clock; initializes state STOPPED, position 0.0, volume 1.0, muted False. If playlist not empty, current selection is as in Playlist (index 0 by default).\\n  - state(self) -> PlaybackState: returns current playback state.\\n  - current_media(self) -> Media | None: returns playlist.current().\\n  - position_seconds(self) -> float: current position within current media in seconds; 0.0 when no selection.\\n  - duration_seconds(self) -> float: duration of current media in seconds; 0.0 when no selection.\\n  - play(self) -> None: transitions to PLAYING if a media is selected; if playlist is empty, raises StateError; if at end (position >= duration), resets to 0.0 before playing.\\n  - pause(self) -> None: transitions to PAUSED from PLAYING; no-op if already PAUSED or STOPPED (remains STOPPED).\\n  - stop(self) -> None: transitions to STOPPED and resets position to 0.0.\\n  - seek(self, seconds: float) -> float: clamps seconds to [0.0, duration_seconds()] and sets position; returns the effective position. If no media selected, returns 0.0 and leaves state STOPPED. Raises ValidationError for NaN or negative infinite values; finite negatives clamp to 0.0.\\n  - set_volume(self, v: float) -> float: sets volume to clamp(v, 0.0, 1.0); returns effective volume.\\n  - get_volume(self) -> float: returns current volume (0.0..1.0), independent of muted flag.\\n  - mute(self) -> None: sets muted True.\\n  - unmute(self) -> None: sets muted False.\\n  - toggle_mute(self) -> bool: flips muted and returns new muted state.\\n  - effective_volume(self) -> float: returns 0.0 if muted else get_volume().\\n  - next_media(self) -> Media | None: requests playlist.next(); if a next item exists, resets position to 0.0 and sets state to STOPPED; returns the Media or None if at end.\\n  - previous_media(self) -> Media | None: requests playlist.previous(); if a previous item exists, resets position to 0.0 and sets state to STOPPED; returns the Media or None if at start.\\n  - select_index(self, i: int) -> Media: delegates to playlist.select(i); resets position to 0.0 and sets state to STOPPED; returns selected Media.\\n  - _on_tick(self, delta: float) -> None: internal; invoked by ManualClock ticks; advances position only when state is PLAYING and a current media exists; clamps at duration and transitions to STOPPED when reaching or exceeding end, leaving position at exact duration.\\n  - _reset_position(self) -> None: internal; sets position to 0.0.\\n\\nSemantics\\n- Deterministic, headless, tick-driven: Player time advances only via ManualClock.tick calls; no wall-clock usage. End-of-media behavior: when position + delta >= duration, set position to duration and set state to STOPPED.\\n- No I/O, no GUI/audio/network/filesystem side effects anywhere in core modules.\\n\\n__init__ exports (video_player.__init__)\\n- from .errors import ValidationError, StateError, NotFoundError\\n- from .media import Media\\n- from .clock import ManualClock\\n- from .playlist import Playlist\\n- from .player import Player, PlaybackState\\n\\nImport constraints\\n- errors is leaf; media imports errors; playlist imports media and errors; player imports errors, media, playlist, and clock; clock imports nothing from domain; __init__ re-exports only.\\n\\nRuntime entry (Main.py)\\n- Constructs a small list of Media, a Playlist, a ManualClock, and a Player.   - remove_tick_listener(self, fn) -> None: unregisters a previously added listener; no-op if not present.
  - tick(self, delta_seconds: float) -> None: advances clock by delta_seconds (> 0) and synchronously notifies listeners via fn(delta_seconds). Raises ValidationError if delta_seconds <= 0.

Playlist (video_player.playlist)
- class Playlist:
  - __init__(self, items: list[Media]): stores an immutable snapshot list of Media; initial _current_index is 0 if non-empty else None.
  - is_empty(self) -> bool: True if no items.
  - size(self) -> int: number of items.
  - current(self) -> Media | None: current Media if selected else None.
  - select(self, index: int) -> Media: selects and returns item at index; raises NotFoundError for out-of-range; sets current index to index.
  - next(self) -> Media | None: if empty, return None; if at last item, keep last and return None; otherwise advance index by 1 and return the new current item.
  - previous(self) -> Media | None: if empty, return None; if at first item, keep first and return None; otherwise decrement index by 1 and return the new current item.
  - Invariants: indices are 0-based; navigation does not wrap; selection maintains bounds.

PlaybackState (video_player.player)
- enum-like class PlaybackState with three members: STOPPED, PLAYING, PAUSED. Comparable by identity or value; string reprs stable.

Player (video_player.player)
- class Player:
  - __init__(self, playlist: Playlist, clock: ManualClock): subscribes an internal _on_tick listener to clock; initializes state STOPPED, position 0.0, volume 1.0, muted False. If playlist not empty, current selection is as in Playlist (index 0 by default).
  - state(self) -> PlaybackState: returns current playback state.
  - current_media(self) -> Media | None: returns playlist.current().
  - position_seconds(self) -> float: current position within current media in seconds; 0.0 when no selection.
  - duration_seconds(self) -> float: duration of current media in seconds; 0.0 when no selection.
  - play(self) -> None: transitions to PLAYING if a media is selected; if playlist is empty, raises StateError; if at end (position >= duration), resets to 0.0 before playing.
  - pause(self) -> None: transitions to PAUSED from PLAYING; no-op if already PAUSED or STOPPED (remains STOPPED).
  - stop(self) -> None: transitions to STOPPED and resets position to 0.0.
  - seek(self, seconds: float) -> float: clamps seconds to [0.0, duration_seconds()] and sets position; returns the effective position. If no media selected, returns 0.0 and leaves state STOPPED. Raises ValidationError for NaN or negative infinite values; finite negatives clamp to 0.0.
  - set_volume(self, v: float) -> float: sets volume to clamp(v, 0.0, 1.0); returns effective volume.
  - get_volume(self) -> float: returns current volume (0.0..1.0), independent of muted flag.
  - mute(self) -> None: sets muted True.
  - unmute(self) -> None: sets muted False.
  - toggle_mute(self) -> bool: flips muted and returns new muted state.
  - effective_volume(self) -> float: returns 0.0 if muted else get_volume().
  - next_media(self) -> Media | None: requests playlist.next(); if a next item exists, resets position to 0.0 and sets state to STOPPED; returns the Media or None if at end.
  - previous_media(self) -> Media | None: requests playlist.previous(); if a previous item exists, resets position to 0.0 and sets state to STOPPED; returns the Media or None if at start.
  - select_index(self, i: int) -> Media: delegates to playlist.select(i); resets position to 0.0 and sets state to STOPPED; returns selected Media.
  - _on_tick(self, delta: float) -> None: internal; invoked by ManualClock ticks; advances position only when state is PLAYING and a current media exists; clamps at duration and transitions to STOPPED when reaching or exceeding end, leaving position at exact duration.
  - _reset_position(self) -> None: internal; sets position to 0.0.

Semantics
- Deterministic, headless, tick-driven: Player time advances only via ManualClock.tick calls; no wall-clock usage. End-of-media behavior: when position + delta >= duration, set position to duration and set state to STOPPED.
- No I/O, no GUI/audio/network/filesystem side effects anywhere in core modules.

__init__ exports (video_player.__init__)
- from .errors import ValidationError, StateError, NotFoundError
- from .media import Media
- from .clock import ManualClock
- from .playlist import Playlist
- from .player import Player, PlaybackState

Import constraints
- errors is leaf; media imports errors; playlist imports media and errors; player imports errors, media, playlist, and clock; clock imports nothing from domain; __init__ re-exports only.

Runtime entry (Main.py)
- Constructs a small list of Media, a Playlist, a ManualClock, and a Player. Demonstrates play/pause/seek/next and ticks deterministically, then exits without interaction or I/O.","Shared Knowledge":"The project provides a headless, deterministic video player domain. - avoid network access and OS-specific behavior during build, tests, and runtime checks
- all planned source, header, build, and test files must be listed exactly and consistently in the design and task documents

- avoid network access and OS-specific behavior during build, tests, and runtime checks

metagpt.actions.add_requirement.UserRequ.content:
Generate a complete medium-size Python 3.10 repository architecture for: Video player.

This architecture will be implemented later by a seeded local code model and evaluated automatically. Produce concrete design and implementation tasks for every file; do not use placeholders.

Normative evaluator protocol (these paths are mandatory and override preferences):
- build file: requirements.txt
- runtime entry: Main.py
- single test target: tests/test_main.py
- test command: python -m pytest -q
- keep exactly one protocol-level test file; additional non-test implementation files are allowed

Language/layout constraints:
Keep Main.py as a thin entrypoint and put reusable modules in a lowercase snake_case package. List pytest in requirements.txt and avoid other external dependencies unless essential. Target Python 3.10 exactly: do not use typing.Self, StrEnum, exception groups, or other Python 3.11+ APIs. Design an acyclic import graph: foundational types/errors may not import engines, entrypoints, or demos; __init__.py may export only symbols actually defined by submodules.

Medium-size target from MetaProjectDev (an approximate architecture target, not permission to violate the protocol):
- about 9 repository files
- about 37 functions or methods
- about 786 lines of code

File-count quality gate:
- the complete Task list MUST contain between 8 and 10 files inclusive
- count build, runtime, test, package markers, headers, and implementation files in that total
- combine closely related small types instead of exceeding this budget

Required domain behavior:
- media metadata
- playlist navigation
- play pause and stop state
- seek and duration bounds
- volume and mute
- headless deterministic playback clock

Cross-cutting requirements:
- separate pure domain logic from runtime, UI, filesystem, network, clock, and randomness boundaries
- automated tests must be deterministic, headless, offline, and require no manual interaction
- keep the single test target concise (2 to 4 tests, preferably under 150 LOC): cover runtime wiring and representative core rules, not the full feature matrix
- do not inflate the function/LOC target with test code; put substantive behavior in implementation files
- make every planned file small enough for one 4096-token code completion: prefer under 150 LOC and never plan a file over 220 LOC
- order the Task list strictly by implementation dependency: foundational types and interfaces first, then dependent implementations, then the runtime entry, and the single test target LAST (the build descriptor may be first)
- the Engineer code_todos must preserve that dependency-first Task-list order so later files can see already-generated dependency code
- the runtime entry must provide a small non-interactive demonstration that exits successfully or starts safely without an output loop
- validate invalid inputs and boundary cases
- keep public interfaces coherent across design, task list, implementation, and tests
- specify one canonical public API; tests must use it without inventing alternate semantics
- make Full API spec non-empty and exhaustive: for every public type/function give its exact module, signature, return value, error behavior, and key semantics; repeat these exact contracts in each affected file task
- tests may import only the canonical public API and should assert stable externally visible behavior, not private implementation details, incidental formatting, or unplanned aliases
- avoid circular dependencies; explicitly give the allowed import/include direction and ensure every referenced symbol is defined before a dependent file is generated
- avoid network access and OS-specific behavior during build, tests, and runtime checks
- all planned source, header, build, and test files must be listed exactly and consistently in the design and task documents

  - __init__(self, playlist: Playlist, clock: ManualClock): subscribes an internal _on_tick listener to clock; initializes state STOPPED, position 0.0, volume 1.0, muted False. If playlist not empty, current selection is as in Playlist (index 0 by default).
  - state(self) -> PlaybackState: returns current playback state.
  - current_media(self) -> Media | None: returns playlist.current().
  - position_seconds(self) -> float: current position within current media in seconds; 0.0 when no selection.
  - duration_seconds(self) -> float: duration of current media in seconds; 0.0 when no selection.
  - play(self) -> None: transitions to PLAYING if a media is selected; if playlist is empty, raises StateError; if at end (position >= duration), resets to 0.0 before playing.
  - pause(self) -> None: transitions to PAUSED from PLAYING; no-op if already PAUSED or STOPPED (remains STOPPED).
  - stop(self) -> None: transitions to STOPPED and resets position to 0.0.
  - seek(self, seconds: float) -> float: clamps seconds to [0.0, duration_seconds()] and sets position; returns the effective position. If no media selected, returns 0.0 and leaves state STOPPED. Raises ValidationError for NaN or negative infinite values; finite negatives clamp to 0.0.
  - set_volume(self, v: float) -> float: sets volume to clamp(v, 0.0, 1.0); returns effective volume.
  - get_volume(self) -> float: returns current volume (0.0..1.0), independent of muted flag.
  - mute(self) -> None: sets muted True.
  - unmute(self) -> None: sets muted False.
  - toggle_mute(self) -> bool: flips muted and returns new muted state.
  - effective_volume(self) -> float: returns 0.0 if muted else get_volume().
  - next_media(self) -> Media | None: requests playlist.next(); if a next item exists, resets position to 0.0 and sets state to STOPPED; returns the Media or None if at end.
  - previous_media(self) -> Media | None: requests playlist.previous(); if a previous item exists, resets position to 0.0 and sets state to STOPPED; returns the Media or None if at start.
  - select_index(self, i: int) -> Media: delegates to playlist.select(i); resets position to 0.0 and sets state to STOPPED; returns selected Media.
  - _on_tick(self, delta: float) -> None: internal; invoked by ManualClock ticks; advances position only when state is PLAYING and a current media exists; clamps at duration and transitions to STOPPED when reaching or exceeding end, leaving position at exact duration.
  - _reset_position(self) -> None: internal; sets position to 0.0.

Semantics
- Deterministic, headless, tick-driven: Player time advances only via ManualClock.tick calls; no wall-clock usage. End-of-media behavior: when position + delta >= duration, set position to duration and set state to STOPPED.
- No I/O, no GUI/audio/network/filesystem side effects anywhere in core modules.

Exceptions (video_player.errors)
- class ValidationError(Exception): raised for invalid inputs and configuration.
- class StateError(ValidationError): raised for invalid state transitions (e.g., play with empty playlist).
- class NotFoundError(ValidationError): raised when addressing non-existent playlist indices/items.

Entity: Media (video_player.media)
- class Media:
  - __init__(self, id: str, title: str, duration_seconds: float, metadata: Optional[dict] = None)
    - id: non-empty str
    - title: non-empty str

Clock: ManualClock (video_player.clock)
- class ManualClock:
  - now(self) -> float: returns accumulated clock time in seconds.
  - add_tick_listener(self, fn: Callable[[float], None]) -> None: registers a listener to receive tick deltas; idempotent add allowed; listener called synchronously on tick in registration order.
  - remove_tick_listener(self, fn) -> None: unregisters a previously added listener; no-op if not present.
  - tick(self, delta_seconds: float) -> None: advances clock by delta_seconds (> 0) and synchronously notifies listeners via fn(delta_seconds). Raises ValidationError if delta_seconds <= 0.

Playlist (video_player.playlist)
- class Playlist:
  - __init__(self, items: list[Media]): stores an immutable snapshot list of Media; initial _current_index is 0 if non-empty else None.
  - is_empty(self) -> bool: True if no items.
  - size(self) -> int: number of items.
  - current(self) -> Media | None: current Media if selected else None.
  - select(self, index: int) -> Media: selects and returns item at index; raises NotFoundError for out-of-range; sets current index to index.
  - next(self) -> Media | None: if empty, return None; if at last item, keep last and return None; otherwise advance index by 1 and return the new current item.
  - previous(self) -> Media | None: if empty, return None; if at first item, keep first and return None; otherwise decrement index by 1 and return the new current item.
  - Invariants: indices are 0-based; navigation does not wrap; selection maintains bounds.

PlaybackState (video_player.player)
- enum-like class PlaybackState with three members: STOPPED, PLAYING, PAUSED. Comparable by identity or value; string reprs stable.

Player (video_player.player)
- class Player:
  - __init__(self, playlist: Playlist, clock: ManualClock): subscribes an internal _on_tick listener to clock; initializes state STOPPED, position 0.0, volume 1.0, muted False. If playlist not empty, current selection is as in Playlist (index 0 by default).

  - current_media(self) -> Media | None: returns playlist.current().

  - duration_seconds(self) -> float: duration of current media in seconds; 0.0 when no selection.
  - play(self) -> None: transitions to PLAYING if a media is selected; if playlist is empty, raises StateError; if at end (position >= duration), resets to 0.0 before playing.
  - pause(self) -> None: transitions to PAUSED from PLAYING; no-op if already PAUSED or STOPPED (remains STOPPED).
  - stop(self) -> None: transitions to STOPPED and resets position to 0.0.
  - seek(self, seconds: float) -> float: clamps seconds to [0.0, duration_seconds()] and sets position; returns the effective position. If no media selected, returns 0.0 and leaves state STOPPED. Raises ValidationError for NaN or negative infinite values; finite negatives clamp to 0.0.
  - set_volume(self, v: float) -> float: sets volume to clamp(v, 0.0, 1.0); returns effective volume.
  - get_volume(self) -> float: returns current volume (0.0..1.0), independent of muted flag.
  - mute(self) -> None: sets muted True.
  - unmute(self) -> None: sets muted False.
  - toggle_mute(self) -> bool: flips muted and returns new muted state.
  - effective_volume(self) -> float: returns 0.0 if muted else get_volume().
  - next_media(self) -> Media | None: requests playlist.next(); if a next item exists, resets position to 0.0 and sets state to STOPPED; returns the Media or None if at end.

  - select_index(self, i: int) -> Media: delegates to playlist.select(i); resets position to 0.0 and sets state to STOPPED; returns selected Media.
  - _on_tick(self, delta: float) -> None: internal; invoked by ManualClock ticks; advances position only when state is PLAYING and a current media exists; clamps at duration and transitions to STOPPED when reaching or exceeding end, leaving position at exact duration.
  - _reset_position(self) -> None: internal; sets position to 0.0.

Package: video_player
- video_player.__init__ re-exports: ValidationError, StateError, NotFoundError; Media; ManualClock; Playlist; Player; PlaybackState.
- Import graph must be acyclic: errors -> media -> playlist -> player; clock is orthogonal and imported by player only; tests and Main.py import from video_player or submodules without creating cycles.

Exceptions (video_player.errors)
- class ValidationError(Exception): raised for invalid inputs and configuration.
- class StateError(ValidationError): raised for invalid state transitions (e.g., play with empty playlist).
- class NotFoundError(ValidationError): raised when addressing non-existent playlist indices/items.

Entity: Media (video_player.media)
- class Media:
  - __init__(self, id: str, title: str, duration_seconds: float, metadata: Optional[dict] = None)
    - id: non-empty str
    - title: non-empty str
    - duration_seconds: float > 0
    - metadata: optional dict; stored as a shallow copy; object is immutable after construction (no setters; attributes may be read-only via properties or by convention).
  - Attributes (public, read-only): id, title, duration_seconds, metadata (a shallow-copied dict or {})
  - Errors: ValidationError for invalid field types/values.

Clock: ManualClock (video_player.clock)
- class ManualClock:
  - now(self) -> float: returns accumulated clock time in seconds.
  - add_tick_listener(self, fn: Callable[[float], None]) -> None: registers a listener to receive tick deltas; idempotent add allowed; listener called synchronously on tick in registration order.
  - remove_tick_listener(self, fn) -> None: unregisters a previously added listener; no-op if not present.
  - tick(self, delta_seconds: float) -> None: advances clock by delta_seconds (> 0) and synchronously notifies listeners via fn(delta_seconds). Raises ValidationError if delta_seconds <= 0.

Playlist (video_player.playlist)
- class Playlist:
  - __init__(self, items: list[Media]): stores an immutable snapshot list of Media; initial _current_index is 0 if non-empty else None.
  - is_empty(self) -> bool: True if no items.
  - size(self) -> int: number of items.
  - current(self) -> Media | None: current Media if selected else None.
  - select(self, index: int) -> Media: selects and returns item at index; raises NotFoundError for out-of-range; sets current index to index.
  - next(self) -> Media | None: if empty, return None; if at last item, keep last and return None; otherwise advance index by 1 and return the new current item.
  - previous(self) -> Media | None: if empty, return None; if at first item, keep first and return None; otherwise decrement index by 1 and return the new current item.
  - Invariants: indices are 0-based; navigation does not wrap; selection maintains bounds.

PlaybackState (video_player.player)
- enum-like class PlaybackState with three members: STOPPED, PLAYING, PAUSED. Comparable by identity or value; string reprs stable.

Player (video_player.player)
- class Player:
  - __init__(self, playlist: Playlist, clock: ManualClock): subscribes an internal _on_tick listener to clock; initializes state STOPPED, position 0.0, volume 1.0, muted False. If playlist not empty, current selection is as in Playlist (index 0 by default).
  - state(self) -> PlaybackState: returns current playback state.
  - current_media(self) -> Media | None: returns playlist.current().
  - position_seconds(self) -> float: current position within current media in seconds; 0.0 when no selection.
  - duration_seconds(self) -> float: duration of current media in seconds; 0.0 when no selection.
  - play(self) -> None: transitions to PLAYING if a media is selected; if playlist is empty, raises StateError; if at end (position >= duration), resets to 0.0 before playing.
  - pause(self) -> None: transitions to PAUSED from PLAYING; no-op if already PAUSED or STOPPED (remains STOPPED).
  - stop(self) -> None: transitions to STOPPED and resets position to 0.0.
  - seek(self, seconds: float) -> float: clamps seconds to [0.0, duration_seconds()] and sets position; returns the effective position. If no media selected, returns 0.0 and leaves state STOPPED. Raises ValidationError for NaN or negative infinite values; finite negatives clamp to 0.0.
  - set_volume(self, v: float) -> float: sets volume to clamp(v, 0.0, 1.0); returns effective volume.
  - get_volume(self) -> float: returns current volume (0.0..1.0), independent of muted flag.
  - mute(self) -> None: sets muted True.
  - unmute(self) -> None: sets muted False.
  - toggle_mute(self) -> bool: flips muted and returns new muted state.
  - effective_volume(self) -> float: returns 0.0 if muted else get_volume().
  - next_media(self) -> Media | None: requests playlist.next(); if a next item exists, resets position to 0.0 and sets state to STOPPED; returns the Media or None if at end.
  - previous_media(self) -> Media | None: requests playlist.previous(); if a previous item exists, resets position to 0.0 and sets state to STOPPED; returns the Media or None if at start.
  - select_index(self, i: int) -> Media: delegates to playlist.select(i); resets position to 0.0 and sets state to STOPPED; returns selected Media.
  - _on_tick(self, delta: float) -> None: internal; invoked by ManualClock ticks; advances position only when state is PLAYING and a current media exists; clamps at duration and transitions to STOPPED when reaching or exceeding end, leaving position at exact duration.
  - _reset_position(self) -> None: internal; sets position to 0.0.

Semantics
- Deterministic, headless, tick-driven: Player time advances only via ManualClock.tick calls; no wall-clock usage. End-of-media behavior: when position + delta >= duration, set position to duration and set state to STOPPED.
- No I/O, no GUI/audio/network/filesystem side effects anywhere in core modules.

__init__ exports (video_player.__init__)
- from .errors import ValidationError, StateError, NotFoundError
- from .media import Media
- from .clock import ManualClock
- from .playlist import Playlist
- from .player import Player, PlaybackState

Import constraints
- errors is leaf; media imports errors; playlist imports media and errors; player imports errors, media, playlist, and clock; clock imports nothing from domain; __init__ re-exports only.

Runtime entry (Main.py)

This architecture will be implemented later by a seeded local code model and evaluated automatically. Produce concrete design and implementation tasks for every file; do not use placeholders.

Normative evaluator protocol (these paths are mandatory and override preferences):
- build file: requirements.txt
- runtime entry: Main.py
- single test target: tests/test_main.py
- test command: python -m pytest -q
- keep exactly one protocol-level test file; additional non-test implementation files are allowed

Language/layout constraints:
Keep Main.py as a thin entrypoint and put reusable modules in a lowercase snake_case package. List pytest in requirements.txt and avoid other external dependencies unless essential. Target Python 3.10 exactly: do not use typing.Self, StrEnum, exception groups, or other Python 3.11+ APIs. Design an acyclic import graph: foundational types/errors may not import engines, entrypoints, or demos; __init__.py may export only symbols actually defined by submodules.

Medium-size target from MetaProjectDev (an approximate architecture target, not permission to violate the protocol):
- about 9 repository files
- about 37 functions or methods
- about 786 lines of code

File-count quality gate:
- the complete Task list MUST contain between 8 and 10 files inclusive
- count build, runtime, test, package markers, headers, and implementation files in that total
- combine closely related small types instead of exceeding this budget

Required domain behavior:
- media metadata
- playlist navigation
- play pause and stop state
- seek and duration bounds
- volume and mute
- headless deterministic playback clock

Cross-cutting requirements:
- separate pure domain logic from runtime, UI, filesystem, network, clock, and randomness boundaries
- automated tests must be deterministic, headless, offline, and require no manual interaction
- keep the single test target concise (2 to 4 tests, preferably under 150 LOC): cover runtime wiring and representative core rules, not the full feature matrix
- do not inflate the function/LOC target with test code; put substantive behavior in implementation files
- make every planned file small enough for one 4096-token code completion: prefer under 150 LOC and never plan a file over 220 LOC
- order the Task list strictly by implementation dependency: foundational types and interfaces first, then dependent implementations, then the runtime entry, and the single test target LAST (the build descriptor may be first)
- the Engineer code_todos must preserve that dependency-first Task-list order so later files can see already-generated dependency code
- the runtime entry must provide a small non-interactive demonstration that exits successfully or starts safely without an output loop
- validate invalid inputs and boundary cases
- keep public interfaces coherent across design, task list, implementation, and tests
- specify one canonical public API; tests must use it without inventing alternate semantics
- make Full API spec non-empty and exhaustive: for every public type/function give its exact module, signature, return value, error behavior, and key semantics; repeat these exact contracts in each affected file task
- tests may import only the canonical public API and should assert stable externally visible behavior, not private implementation details, incidental formatting, or unplanned aliases
- avoid circular dependencies; explicitly give the allowed import/include direction and ensure every referenced symbol is defined before a dependent file is generated
- avoid network access and OS-specific behavior during build, tests, and runtime checks
- all planned source, header, build, and test files must be listed exactly and consistently in the design and task documents

- class ValidationError(Exception): raised for invalid inputs and configuration.

- class Media:
  - __init__(self, id: str, title: str, duration_seconds: float, metadata: Optional[dict] = None)

Clock: ManualClock (video_player.clock)
- class ManualClock:
  - now(self) -> float: returns accumulated clock time in seconds.
  - add_tick_listener(self, fn: Callable[[float], None]) -> None: registers a listener to receive tick deltas; idempotent add allowed; listener called synchronously on tick in registration order.
  - remove_tick_listener(self, fn) -> None: unregisters a previously added listener; no-op if not present.
  - tick(self, delta_seconds: float) -> None: advances clock by delta_seconds (> 0) and synchronously notifies listeners via fn(delta_seconds). Raises ValidationError if delta_seconds <= 0.

Playlist (video_player.playlist)
- class Playlist:
  - __init__(self, items: list[Media]): stores an immutable snapshot list of Media; initial _current_index is 0 if non-empty else None.
  - is_empty(self) -> bool: True if no items.
  - size(self) -> int: number of items.
  - current(self) -> Media | None: current Media if selected else None.
  - select(self, index: int) -> Media: selects and returns item at index; raises NotFoundError for out-of-range; sets current index to index.
  - next(self) -> Media | None: if empty, return None; if at last item, keep last and return None; otherwise advance index by 1 and return the new current item.
  - previous(self) -> Media | None: if empty, return None; if at first item, keep first and return None; otherwise decrement index by 1 and return the new current item.
  - Invariants: indices are 0-based; navigation does not wrap; selection maintains bounds.

PlaybackState (video_player.player)
- enum-like class PlaybackState with three members: STOPPED, PLAYING, PAUSED. Comparable by identity or value; string reprs stable.

Player (video_player.player)
- class Player:
  - __init__(self, playlist: Playlist, clock: ManualClock): subscribes an internal _on_tick listener to clock; initializes state STOPPED, position 0.0, volume 1.0, muted False. If playlist not empty, current selection is as in Playlist (index 0 by default).
  - state(self) -> PlaybackState: returns current playback state.
  - current_media(self) -> Media | None: returns playlist.current().
  - position_seconds(self) -> float: current position within current media in seconds; 0.0 when no selection.
  - duration_seconds(self) -> float: duration of current media in seconds; 0.0 when no selection.
  - play(self) -> None: transitions to PLAYING if a media is selected; if playlist is empty, raises StateError; if at end (position >= duration), resets to 0.0 before playing.
  - pause(self) -> None: transitions to PAUSED from PLAYING; no-op if already PAUSED or STOPPED (remains STOPPED).
  - stop(self) -> None: transitions to STOPPED and resets position to 0.0.
  - seek(self, seconds: float) -> float: clamps seconds to [0.0, duration_seconds()] and sets position; returns the effective position. If no media selected, returns 0.0 and leaves state STOPPED. Raises ValidationError for NaN or negative infinite values; finite negatives clamp to 0.0.
  - set_volume(self, v: float) -> float: sets volume to clamp(v, 0.0, 1.0); returns effective volume.
  - get_volume(self) -> float: returns current volume (0.0..1.0), independent of muted flag.
  - mute(self) -> None: sets muted True.
  - unmute(self) -> None: sets muted False.
  - toggle_mute(self) -> bool: flips muted and returns new muted state.
  - effective_volume(self) -> float: returns 0.0 if muted else get_volume().
  - next_media(self) -> Media | None: requests playlist.next(); if a next item exists, resets position to 0.0 and sets state to STOPPED; returns the Media or None if at end.
  - previous_media(self) -> Media | None: requests playlist.previous(); if a previous item exists, resets position to 0.0 and sets state to STOPPED; returns the Media or None if at start.
  - select_index(self, i: int) -> Media: delegates to playlist.select(i); resets position to 0.0 and sets state to STOPPED; returns selected Media.
  - _on_tick(self, delta: float) -> None: internal; invoked by ManualClock ticks; advances position only when state is PLAYING and a current media exists; clamps at duration and transitions to STOPPED when reaching or exceeding end, leaving position at exact duration.
  - _reset_position(self) -> None: internal; sets position to 0.0.

- Deterministic, headless, tick-driven: Player time advances only via ManualClock.tick calls; no wall-clock usage. End-of-media behavior: when position + delta >= duration, set position to duration and set state to STOPPED.
